requirements.quote:
All numeric values are encoded in network byte order (that is, big
   endian), and all field sizes are in bits.  Hexadecimal notation is
   used for describing the value of fields.
requirements.condition: When encoding any numeric value in a packet format.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the numeric value in network byte order (big endian).
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not encode numeric values using any other byte order.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet bytes can be inspected to verify that every multibyte numeric value uses big-endian ordering.

requirements.quote:
All numeric values are encoded in network byte order (that is, big
   endian), and all field sizes are in bits.  Hexadecimal notation is
   used for describing the value of fields.
requirements.condition: When interpreting field-size specifications in the packet formats.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret every stated field size as a number of bits.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not interpret field sizes as bytes or another unit.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation's packet field widths and resulting layout can be compared against the specified bit counts.
